text: Zoom through your own images instead of prompts. Image 1 is the center of the zoom and the last image is the outermost frame. Render settings (Main tab), Video, Music & Keyframes, Mask Blur (Outpaint tab) and Post process apply here too.
html: Zoom through your own images instead of prompts. Image 1 is the center of the zoom and the last image is the outermost frame. Render settings (Main tab), Video, Music & Keyframes, Mask Blur (Outpaint tab) and Post process apply here too.

text: Paste or upload keyframes from the audio keyframe generator (Disco, PyTTI or CSV) or from Deforum. With keyframes the zoom follows their pace and the video lasts as long as the keyframes; leave empty for the classic steady zoom.
